hostNotes: Open-ended starter: almost any genuinely Australian colloquialism is correct, so grade generously and lean on the bank for grouping variants (e.g. parma/parmi, sanga/sanger/sambo, yeah nah vs nah yeah are listed separately but a host may merge them). Reject plain brand names (Vegemite, VB), ordinary English words, and purely British or American slang unless the Aussie usage is distinctive (knackered, dodgy, telly are accepted; blimey, dude are not). Watch the traps: 'root' and 'thongs' mean different things to Americans; 'wog' is a slur that some will offer and is technically correct, so decide before the round whether to accept it; Aboriginal-English words (deadly, mob, gammon) are correct Aussie slang. Loanwords like billabong, yabby and joey are borderline but appear on every slang list, so accept them.
